name: SR-021
summary: I read the changed skills/application-materials/SKILL.md (step 5) and references/drafting-workflow.md (cover-letter motivation paragraph, line 53). I did not run a session case. The questions are required on every letter, which covers EX-1. The drafting reference asks all three (why this company, other motivations, what to put forward) 'even when evidence looks sufficient', and both files say to wait for answers. A no-letter employer instruction removes the letter and the questions, which covers EX-3. EX-2 and the 'or an explicit skip' part of SR-021 are contradicted. The drafting reference now says 'there is no skip path, so never draft the letter without them'. The old text that permitted a provisional neutral opening with the gap noted in notes was deleted. So when the owner skips, the changed skill gives no route to a neutral opening with the gap noted, and it forbids drafting. The change fits 'always ask' but drops the skip handling that SR-021 and EX-2 require.
